items.label: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

items.label: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
items.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

items.label: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
items.summary: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

items.label: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in
items.summary: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.
